mapper.select: SELECT cb.id, cs.id AS schedule_id, c.name AS course_name, c.cover_image AS course_cover, c.course_type, su.nickname AS coach_name, cs.schedule_date, cs.start_time, cs.end_time, cs.location, cb.status, cb.booked_at, cb.cancelled_at FROM course_booking cb INNER JOIN course_schedule cs ON cb.schedule_id = cs.id INNER JOIN course c ON cs.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON cs.coach_id = su.id WHERE cb.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY cs.schedule_date DESC, cs.start_time DESC

SELECT cb.id, cb.user_id, u.nickname AS user_name, cs.id AS schedule_id, c.name AS course_name, sc.nickname AS coach_name, cs.schedule_date, cs.start_time, cs.end_time, cb.status, cb.booked_at, cb.cancelled_at, cb.created_at FROM course_booking cb INNER JOIN course_schedule cs ON cb.schedule_id = cs.id INNER JOIN course c ON cs.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON cb.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_user sc ON cs.coach_id = sc.id WHERE cb.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} ORDER BY cb.booked_at ASC
